name: @activepieces/piece-fathom
description: Fathom is an AI meeting assistant that automatically records, transcribes, highlights, and generates AI summaries and action items from your meetings. Integrate with workflows to react to meeting events and retrieve meeting data.

auth.description: Connect your Fathom account using OAuth2.

getRecordingSummary.name: getRecordingSummary
getRecordingSummary.description: Get the AI-generated summary of a meeting recording. Note: This action requires API Key authentication and is not available when using OAuth2.

auth.description: Connect your Fathom account using OAuth2.

recording_id.description: Select the meeting recording to get the summary for

destination_url.description: Optional: URL where Fathom will POST the summary. Leave empty to get data directly in response.

aiMetadata.description: Retrieve the AI-generated summary of a single Fathom meeting recording, identified by its recording ID. Use to pull a concise recap of what a recorded meeting covered. Read-only and repeatable; optionally supply a destination URL to have Fathom POST the summary there instead of returning it inline. Requires API Key auth (not available under OAuth2).

getRecordingTranscript.name: getRecordingTranscript
getRecordingTranscript.description: Get the AI-generated transcript of a meeting recording. Note: This action requires API Key authentication and is not available when using OAuth2.

auth.description: Connect your Fathom account using OAuth2.

recording_id.description: Select the meeting recording to get the transcript for

destination_url.description: Optional: URL where Fathom will POST the transcript. Leave empty to get data directly in response.

aiMetadata.description: Retrieve the full transcript of a single Fathom meeting recording, identified by its recording ID. Use when you need the verbatim spoken content rather than the summary. Read-only and repeatable; optionally supply a destination URL to have Fathom POST the transcript there instead of returning it inline. Requires API Key auth (not available under OAuth2).

listMeetings.name: listMeetings
listMeetings.description: List meetings with optional filtering and pagination

calendar_invitees.description: Email addresses of calendar invitees to filter by

calendar_invitees_domains.description: Domains of the companies to filter by (e.g., acme.com)

calendar_invitees_domains_type.description: Filter by whether calendar invitee list includes external email domains

recorded_by.description: Email addresses of users who recorded meetings

teams.description: Team names to filter by (e.g., Sales, Engineering)

created_after.description: Filter to meetings created after this timestamp (e.g., 2025-01-01T00:00:00Z)

created_before.description: Filter to meetings created before this timestamp (e.g., 2025-01-01T00:00:00Z)

include_transcript.description: Include the transcript for each meeting

include_summary.description: Include the summary for each meeting

include_action_items.description: Include the action items for each meeting

include_crm_matches.description: Include CRM matches for each meeting

aiMetadata.description: List Fathom meeting recordings, optionally narrowed by filters such as calendar invitees, invitee domains, recorder email, team, and created-before/after timestamps; with no filters it returns all accessible meetings. Use to discover meetings or find a recording ID for other actions. Set the include-transcript / summary / action-items / CRM-matches flags to embed that data per meeting. Read-only and repeatable; use the cursor for pagination.
List the teams in the connected Fathom workspace, used to look up or enumerate teams by name. Read-only and repeatable; use the cursor for pagination across large team lists.

findTeamMember.name: findTeamMember
findTeamMember.description: Find team member based on email

aiMetadata.description: List team members in the connected Fathom workspace, optionally narrowed to a single team by name; with no team supplied it returns members across all teams. Use to look up who belongs to a team. Read-only and repeatable; use the cursor for pagination.

newRecording.name: newRecording
newRecording.description: Fires when a meeting is recorded (i.e. a new meeting recording is produced)

auth.description: Connect your Fathom account using OAuth2.

triggered_for.description: Select which types of recordings should trigger this webhook

include_transcript.description: Include the transcript in the webhook payload

include_summary.description: Include the summary in the webhook payload

include_action_items.description: Include the action items in the webhook payload

include_crm_matches.description: Include CRM matches in the webhook payload

aiMetadata.description: Fires when Fathom finishes producing a new meeting recording, delivering the meeting metadata (and optionally the transcript, summary, action items, and CRM matches). Scope is configurable to any combination of your own recordings, shared external recordings, recordings you shared with your team, and recordings shared across the team.
